_doc: Stream C (play-test 5: T14 reach, T15 caster forms, T16 sceptres). How a wand, staff, sceptre or off-hand focus attacks when you press the basic attack. `styles` = a WAND's behaviour (`item.castStyle`): the first six are Farhold's own six wand behaviours with Farhold's numbers (the `farhold` key names the row in weapons.js WAND_BEHAVIOURS — those numbers are read from there, never from here, so they cannot drift); the rest are Thousandvale's. `shape`: bolt (a projectile through the same flight as a skill's bolt) | cone | beam | nova | lob. `range` in metres is also what `rules.attackRange` answers (T14: the client walks into THIS range before auto-attacking); a nova's reach is `radius x novaReach`. `mult` = share of weapon damage per hit. `castForm` is stream F's six-word vocabulary (projectile | cone | area | beam | fork | shield) for picking a model. `w` = how often a dropped wand comes out this way. `staffStyles` = the two forms Thousandvale adds to Farhold's staff spells (weapons.js STAFF_SPELLS: cone / nova / wave / lob / chain / ground per element), `staffStyleChance` = the share of staves that get one. `focusRiders` = what an off-hand focus adds to the main hand's caster attack; `focusBases` says which focus base carries which. `offhandBolt` = the share of damage an off-hand wand's own bolt deals (Farhold's OFFHAND_DAMAGE is used when absent). js/rules/caster-forms.js writes every card sentence from these numbers.

burst.text: one {el} bolt that bursts wide on impact

seeking.text: one {el} bolt that turns after what you aimed at

heavy.text: one slow {el} bolt that lands hard
